interventions.detail: Used uv venv with Python 3.10 instead of conda python=3.8
Installed CPU-only torch from download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu before modelscope[nlp]
Pre-installed transformers==4.48.3 and huggingface-hub==0.25.* required by the model repo's requirements.txt (runtime pip auto-install fails in pip-less venv)
TokenClassificationPipeline now forwards trust_remote_code to Pipeline.__init__; otherwise the trusted damo model with allow_remote=true is refused
